title: Water Safety & Treatment Wizard
description: Determine if a water source is safe to drink and how to treat it.

steps.prompt: Where did this water come from?
CRITICAL WARNING: Flood water often contains sewage and chemicals.
steps.text: Do NOT drink flood water unless absolutely dying. Standard filters do NOT remove chemicals. Distillation is the only safe method.

steps.prompt: Look at the water in a clear glass. Describe it.

steps.text: Before treating, you MUST filter this water through a t-shirt, coffee filter, or bandana to remove solids. Disinfection works poorly on cloudy water.

steps.prompt: What treatment tools do you have available?
